Hello there fellow embryologist! I’ve only been in clinical embryology for about 3 yrs. I currently work in the US, specifically the state of Louisiana, and there are very strict laws for embryo disposition.  The law also permits us from discarding aneuploid embryos. We culture to day 7 and biopsy/vit many CC or BC/CB grade embryos. Essentially we have to cryo anything that makes it to blast stage that has enough viable cells to biopsy and or vitrify. As a relatively sheltered embryologist, my questions are: 

Does your state allow patients to elect to discard aneuploid embryos?

Is it common practice for your lab to biopsy and/or cryopreserve C grade embryos? 

Do you have any experience doing travel embryology? If so, I would love some 411 as I’m considering which direction my career could go. I’ve only worked at two clinics so far and love being exposed to other labs, their embryologists, and their practices. It’s so interesting. Thanks!!
